integrity: The analytical proof establishes the infinite-time and all-moment statements; the included checker reports finite diagnostics only. Classical reflection, Lp norms and tail-integration methods are credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact for half-line absorption, independent Brownian noises conditional on one constant shared Beta-distributed diffusivity per equal-size group. No claim for time-dependent environments, arbitrary partition shapes or general diffusivity laws beyond the stated stochastic ordering.
title: Block-shared diffusivity creates a sharp first-arrival moment phase diagram
